platform_info.name: e2etest
platform_info.description: Test-only platform for the Playwright e2e suite: the example platform plus a deliberate error trigger. Excluded from release discovery; never deployed to participants.

description.en: This table lists every file found inside the uploaded zip archive together with its size and date information.
description.nl: Deze tabel bevat alle bestanden in het geüploade zip-archief, inclusief grootte en datuminformatie.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one file entry inside the donated zip archive, including its name, original size, compressed size, and last-modified date.

columns.filename: Full path of the file inside the zip archive.
columns.compressed_size: Compressed size in bytes as stored in the zip.
columns.date_modified: ISO 8601 timestamp of the file's last-modified date recorded in the zip.
